scope: chapters 7:1-9:62, all 17 entries; synthesis across all 39 in chapters 1-9

gaps_proposed.reason: The drafter tagged the interruption and missed its content. He asks, waits, and lets her declare the whole story before speaking — full attention before any conclusion — and the narrator records that she saw she was not hidden. PR16's definition names exactly that: listening that uncovers a hidden reality.

PR05 is regular disciplined sharing of resources with the poor, the stranger and the afflicted. This is a single miraculous provision in which the loaves are multiplied rather than shared with discipline. Feeding the hungry is the practice's subject matter, not the practice — the same condition-for-practice substitution declined on Micah 7:1-6.

running_tally: Twenty additions proposed across all books: nine accepted, one in part, ten declined.
prospective_check: PR25 was considered and declined on Luke 9:46-48 before review, applying the known-attractor note added to the brief after the Magnificat correction. First time that note has been used to prevent an error rather than to explain one.
